text: Hello, my stepson is 5 and his temp is 39.1 tonight. I think he hasn't had a wee since this morning, so it's been at least 12 hours, maybe a bit more. I've been with him most of the day and I don't remember him going at all. He also hasn't pooed in about three days and he's quite grumpy about that. Not sure if the two are connected or if I'm reading too much into it, but thought I'd better check.
